-- Verify: check that Google Sunglasses is indeed the top product and show more details
WITH qualifying_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, UNNEST(hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p.v2ProductName = "YouTube Men's Vintage Henley"
    AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
),
customer_purchases AS (
  SELECT qc.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM qualifying_customers qc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s ON qc.fullVisitorId = s.fullVisitorId
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.v2ProductName != "YouTube Men's Vintage Henley"
  GROUP BY qc.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName
)
SELECT v2ProductName, SUM(total_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM customer_purchases
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH product_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    t.fullVisitorId,
    t.visitId,
    t.date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
  GROUP BY t.fullVisitorId, t.visitId, t.date
),
all_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    date,
    totals.pageviews,
    totals.transactions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
)
SELECT 
  SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 6) AS month,
  CASE 
    WHEN a.transactions >= 1 AND COALESCE(p.has_product_revenue, 0) = 1 THEN 'purchase'
    WHEN a.transactions IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.has_product_revenue, 0) = 0 THEN 'non-purchase'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS session_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.fullVisitorId) AS visitor_count,
  AVG(a.pageviews) AS avg_pageviews
FROM all_sessions a
LEFT JOIN product_hits p 
  ON a.fullVisitorId = p.fullVisitorId AND a.visitId = p.visitId AND a.date = p.date
GROUP BY month, session_type
ORDER BY month, session_type

WITH inpatient_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    provider_name,
    AVG(average_total_payments) AS avg_inpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_name
),
outpatient_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    provider_name,
    AVG(average_total_payments) AS avg_outpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_name
)
SELECT 
  i.provider_name,
  i.avg_inpatient_payment,
  o.avg_outpatient_payment,
  i.avg_inpatient_payment + o.avg_outpatient_payment AS combined_avg
FROM inpatient_avg i
JOIN outpatient_avg o ON i.provider_name = o.provider_name
ORDER BY combined_avg DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT nppes_provider_state AS state, 
       SUM(total_claim_count) AS total_claim_count,

FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE drug_name = 'AMLODIPINE BESYLATE'
GROUP BY nppes_provider_state
ORDER BY total_claim_count DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH monthly_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wet,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dew,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wet,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dew,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wet,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dew,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wet,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dew,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wet,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dew,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT
  year,
  month,
  ABS(avg_air - avg_wet) + ABS(avg_air - avg_dew) + ABS(avg_air - avg_sst) + 
  ABS(avg_wet - avg_dew) + ABS(avg_wet - avg_sst) + ABS(avg_dew - avg_sst) AS sum_diff
FROM monthly_avgs
ORDER BY sum_diff ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH rochester_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) * 5.0 / 9.0 - 17.7778 AS temp_c,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) * 2.54 AS prcp_cm,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444 AS wdsp_ms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290' AND year = '2019' AND mo IN ('01','02','03')
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    ROUND(temp_c, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp_cm, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(wdsp_ms, 1) AS wdsp_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wdsp_ma8
  FROM rochester_data
),
with_lags AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    temp_ma8,
    prcp_ma8,
    wdsp_ma8,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_temp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_prcp,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_wdsp,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_wdsp,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_wdsp,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_wdsp,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_wdsp,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_wdsp,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_wdsp,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_wdsp
  FROM with_ma
)
SELECT * FROM with_lags
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date

-- Get the highest precipitation, min temp, and max temp for last 15 days of each year 2013-2016
SELECT 
  CAST(SUBSTR(_TABLE_SUFFIX, 1, 4) AS INT64) AS year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10) ELSE NULL END) AS max_precip_mm,
  MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10) ELSE NULL END) AS min_temp_c,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10) ELSE NULL END) AS max_temp_c
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*`
WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2013' AND '2016'
  AND (
    (SUBSTR(_TABLE_SUFFIX, 1, 4) = '2013' AND date BETWEEN '2013-12-17' AND '2013-12-31')
    OR (SUBSTR(_TABLE_SUFFIX, 1, 4) = '2014' AND date BETWEEN '2014-12-17' AND '2014-12-31')
    OR (SUBSTR(_TABLE_SUFFIX, 1, 4) = '2015' AND date BETWEEN '2015-12-17' AND '2015-12-31')
    OR (SUBSTR(_TABLE_SUFFIX, 1, 4) = '2016' AND date BETWEEN '2016-12-17' AND '2016-12-31')
  )
  AND qflag IS NULL
  AND mflag IS NULL
  AND element IN ('PRCP', 'TMIN', 'TMAX')
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

-- Full query: compute difference per species, then group by fall_color
WITH species_list AS (
    SELECT UPPER(species_scientific_name) as upper_name, fall_color
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`
    WHERE fall_color IS NOT NULL
),
count_1995 AS (
    SELECT UPPER(spc_latin) as upper_spc, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
    WHERE UPPER(spc_latin) IN (SELECT upper_name FROM species_list)
    AND status != 'Dead'
    GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
count_2015 AS (
    SELECT UPPER(spc_latin) as upper_spc, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
    WHERE UPPER(spc_latin) IN (SELECT upper_name FROM species_list)
    AND status = 'Alive'
    GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
species_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        s.upper_name,
        s.fall_color,
        COALESCE(c2.cnt, 0) - COALESCE(c1.cnt, 0) as difference
    FROM species_list s
    LEFT JOIN count_1995 c1 ON s.upper_name = c1.upper_spc
    LEFT JOIN count_2015 c2 ON s.upper_name = c2.upper_spc
)
SELECT 
    fall_color,
    SUM(difference) as total_change
FROM species_diff
GROUP BY fall_color
ORDER BY fall_color

WITH all_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    total_amount,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    mta_tax,
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime,
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE passenger_count > 5
    AND trip_distance >= 10
    AND fare_amount >= 0
    AND tip_amount >= 0
    AND tolls_amount >= 0
    AND mta_tax >= 0
    AND total_amount >= 0
    AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
    AND pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP('2016-07-01 00:00:00')
    AND dropoff_datetime <= TIMESTAMP('2016-07-07 23:59:59')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    total_amount,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    mta_tax,
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime,
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_green_trips_2016`
  WHERE passenger_count > 5
    AND trip_distance >= 10
    AND fare_amount >= 0
    AND tip_amount >= 0
    AND tolls_amount >= 0
    AND mta_tax >= 0
    AND total_amount >= 0
    AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
    AND pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP('2016-07-01 00:00:00')
    AND dropoff_datetime <= TIMESTAMP('2016-07-07 23:59:59')
)
SELECT 
  tz_pick.zone_name AS pickup_zone,
  tz_drop.zone_name AS dropoff_zone,
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(all_trips.dropoff_datetime, all_trips.pickup_datetime, SECOND) AS trip_duration_seconds,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(all_trips.trip_distance, SAFE_DIVIDE(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(all_trips.dropoff_datetime, all_trips.pickup_datetime, SECOND), 3600)) AS speed_mph,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(all_trips.tip_amount, all_trips.total_amount) * 100 AS tip_rate_pct
FROM all_trips
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz_pick
  ON all_trips.pickup_location_id = tz_pick.zone_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz_drop
  ON all_trips.dropoff_location_id = tz_drop.zone_id
ORDER BY all_trips.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT country_name, indicator_name, value, year FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population` WHERE country_name IN ('United States', 'France', 'China', 'Italy', 'Spain', 'Germany', 'Iran, Islamic Rep.') AND indicator_name LIKE '%population%' AND year = 2020

WITH covid_data AS (
  SELECT 
    county_fips_code,
    TRIM(county_name) AS county_name,
    state,
    confirmed_cases,
    deaths
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_usafacts.summary`
  WHERE date = '2020-08-27'
    AND county_fips_code != '00000'
),
census_data AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id,
    total_pop,
    median_age
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2020_5yr`
  WHERE total_pop > 50000
)
SELECT 
  c.county_name AS county,
  c.state AS state,
  cd.median_age,
  cd.total_pop,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.confirmed_cases, cd.total_pop) * 100000, 2) AS cases_per_100k,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.deaths, cd.total_pop) * 100000, 2) AS deaths_per_100k,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.deaths, c.confirmed_cases) * 100, 2) AS case_fatality_rate
FROM covid_data c
JOIN census_data cd
  ON RIGHT(c.county_fips_code, 5) = cd.geo_id
ORDER BY case_fatality_rate DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
  a.geo_id
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr` a
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` b
  ON a.geo_id = b.geo_id
WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '06%'
ORDER BY (b.median_income - a.median_income) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH scoring_events AS (
  SELECT 
    game_clock,
    period,
    elapsed_time_sec,
    team_name AS team,
    team_market,
    event_description,
    points_scored,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY game_id 
      ORDER BY period, elapsed_time_sec, event_id
    ) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE game_id = '95cda731-b593-42cd-8573-621a3d1369dc'
    AND points_scored > 0
)
SELECT 
  game_clock,
  team AS team_that_scored,
  event_description,
  points_scored,
  SUM(CASE WHEN team = 'Wildcats' THEN points_scored ELSE 0 END) 
    OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS wildcats_score,
  SUM(CASE WHEN team = 'Fighting Irish' THEN points_scored ELSE 0 END) 
    OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS fighting_irish_score
FROM scoring_events
ORDER BY rn

WITH max_wins_per_season AS (
  SELECT season, MAX(wins) as max_wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons`
  WHERE season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
  GROUP BY season
),
peak_teams AS (
  SELECT t.season, t.market, t.wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons` t
  JOIN max_wins_per_season m ON t.season = m.season AND t.wins = m.max_wins
  WHERE t.season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
    AND t.market IS NOT NULL
    AND t.market != ''
)
SELECT market, COUNT(*) as peak_seasons
FROM peak_teams
GROUP BY market
ORDER BY peak_seasons DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH google_hiring AS (
  SELECT 
    'Google Overall Hiring' AS data_source,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women AS percent_women,
    gender_us_men AS percent_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
google_representation AS (
  SELECT 
    'Google Overall Representation' AS data_source,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women AS percent_women,
    gender_us_men AS percent_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
bls_tech AS (
  SELECT 
    'BLS Technology Sectors' AS data_source,
    SUM(percent_asian * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) AS race_asian,
    SUM(percent_black_or_african_american * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) AS race_black,
    SUM(percent_hispanic_or_latino * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) AS race_hispanic_latinx,
    SUM(percent_white * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) AS race_white,
    SUM(percent_women * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) AS percent_women,
    1 - SUM(percent_women * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) AS percent_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021
    AND (subsector = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals' 
         OR industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services')
)
SELECT 
  data_source,
  ROUND(race_asian * 100, 1) AS asian_pct,
  ROUND(race_black * 100, 1) AS black_pct,
  ROUND(race_hispanic_latinx * 100, 1) AS hispanic_latinx_pct,
  ROUND(race_white * 100, 1) AS white_pct,
  ROUND(percent_women * 100, 1) AS women_pct,
  ROUND(percent_men * 100, 1) AS men_pct
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM google_hiring
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM google_representation
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM bls_tech
)
ORDER BY 
  CASE data_source 
    WHEN 'Google Overall Hiring' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Google Overall Representation' THEN 2
    WHEN 'BLS Technology Sectors' THEN 3
  END

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    trip_seconds / 60.0 AS trip_minutes,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
),
with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    trip_minutes,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) AS quantile_group
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT 
  quantile_group,
  ROUND(MIN(trip_minutes)) AS min_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(trip_minutes)) AS max_minutes,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  AVG(fare) AS avg_fare
FROM with_quantile
GROUP BY quantile_group

  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53')

  SELECT 
    p.patient_barcode,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
  FROM paad_patients p
  LEFT JOIN mut_data m ON p.patient_barcode = m.ParticipantBarcode
  GROUP BY p.patient_barcode
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    has_kras,
    has_tp53,
    COUNT(*) as observed
  FROM patient_mutations
  GROUP BY has_kras, has_tp53
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(observed) as grand_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_yes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_no,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_yes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_no
  FROM contingency
),
chi_sq AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(POWER(c.observed - SAFE_DIVIDE(
      CASE WHEN c.has_kras = 1 THEN m.kras_yes ELSE m.kras_no END *
      CASE WHEN c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN m.tp53_yes ELSE m.tp53_no END,
      m.grand_total
    ), 2) / SAFE_DIVIDE(
      CASE WHEN c.has_kras = 1 THEN m.kras_yes ELSE m.kras_no END *
      CASE WHEN c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN m.tp53_yes ELSE m.tp53_no END,
      m.grand_total
    )) as chi_squared_statistic
  FROM contingency c, margins m
)

WITH session_params AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'source' THEN val_string END) AS source,
    MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'medium' THEN val_string END) AS medium,
    MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'campaign' THEN val_string END) AS campaign
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      (SELECT CAST(v.value.int_value AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS v WHERE v.key = 'ga_session_id') AS ga_session_id,
      ep.key,
      ep.value.string_value AS val_string
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` AS e
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(e.event_params) AS ep
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
      AND ep.key IN ('source', 'medium', 'campaign', 'ga_session_id')
  )
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN campaign LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(COALESCE(campaign, '')), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(COALESCE(campaign, '')), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$')) THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
           OR medium IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*video.*') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           OR medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail')
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN medium = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR medium = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'push$')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM session_params
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS total_sessions
FROM classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC

  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e.event_name IN ('level_start_quickplay', 'level_end_quickplay', 'level_complete_quickplay', 'level_fail_quickplay', 'level_reset_quickplay', 'level_retry_quickplay')
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180716'
  GROUP BY c.user_pseudo_id, e.event_name
),
first_type_per_user AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    initial_quickplay_type,
    first_quickplay_ts,
    first_quickplay_date
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      user_pseudo_id,
      initial_quickplay_type,
      first_quickplay_ts,
      first_quickplay_date,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id ORDER BY first_quickplay_ts) as rn
    FROM user_initial_quickplay
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
retention_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    initial_quickplay_type,
    first_quickplay_date,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_ADD(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_quickplay_date), INTERVAL 14 DAY)) as retention_date
  FROM first_type_per_user
),
retained_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT rd.user_pseudo_id, rd.initial_quickplay_type
  FROM retention_dates rd
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e2
    ON rd.user_pseudo_id = e2.user_pseudo_id
    AND e2.event_date = rd.retention_date
)
SELECT 
  rd.initial_quickplay_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rd.user_pseudo_id) as total_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ru.user_pseudo_id) as retained_users,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT ru.user_pseudo_id), COUNT(DISTINCT rd.user_pseudo_id)), 4) as retention_rate
FROM retention_dates rd
LEFT JOIN retained_users ru
  ON rd.user_pseudo_id = ru.user_pseudo_id
  AND rd.initial_quickplay_type = ru.initial_quickplay_type
GROUP BY rd.initial_quickplay_type
ORDER BY total_users DESC
